bullets: [1] Initialize  all Weights with random values
[2] Provide one training sample  at a time (and  its corresponding target label)
[3] Go Forward : Start from Input Layer, Calculate  Net_j,O_j  for each layer till reach output layer
[4] Go Backward : Start from Output Layer, Calculate  Δ_ji,W_ji  for each weights of  Output  layer
Δ_ji = η  O_i(1-O_i) (t_i-O_j)     Store: δ_j = O_i(1-O_i) (t_i-O_j)   (for each node at output Layer)
[5] Go Backward : go to previous Layer, Calculate  Δ_ji,W_ji  for each weights of  Hidden  layer
Δ_ji = η  O_i(1-O_j) [ Σ (δ_k w_kj)]  Store: δ_j = O_i(1-O_j) [ Σ (δ_k w_kj)]   (for each node at Hidden Layer)
[6] Repeat  [5]  till reach first hidden layer
Remember: δ_k = δ_j of next layer  (which is already calulated in previous step )
